dialog.title: Delete your account?
dialog.lead: This cannot be undone once the grace period ends.
consequences: Access is disabled immediately — you are signed out everywhere, and any ongoing game session ends in an error.
Data is permanently deleted after {{days}} days, or shortly after.
You can cancel the deletion before that date by signing in again with a Discord code.
dialog.error: Could not schedule the deletion. Please try again.

status.purgeNote: The deletion job runs once a day, so it may happen up to a day later.

scheduled.title: Your account will be deleted
scheduled.lead: Access has been disabled. You have been signed out on every device.
scheduled.cancelBody: Sign in again with a Discord code before that date and the deletion is cancelled. There is no cancel button on this page because you are no longer signed in.

pending.title: Your account will be deleted
pending.lead: The app stays unavailable until you cancel the deletion.
caveats: Sessions that were errored out when you requested deletion, and unregistered devices, do not come back.
Once the data is permanently deleted it cannot be recovered.
pending.notScheduled: This account is not scheduled for deletion.
pending.cancelFailed: Could not cancel the deletion. Please try again.

public.title: Account and data deletion
public.intro: You can delete your GameTrace account and its data at any time, or delete parts of your data without closing your account. Here is how, what is removed, and what is kept.
steps: Sign in on the web or in the Android app (code from the /login command on Discord).
Choose "Delete account" and confirm as prompted (on the web, by typing your username).
public.graceBody: The account is disabled immediately — you are signed out everywhere. Data is permanently deleted after {{days}} days; the deletion job runs once a day, so it may happen up to a day after that date.
public.cancelBody: Within those {{days}} days you can cancel by signing in again — you will be shown a screen with a cancel button. After that the data cannot be recovered.
inventory: Game sessions and your full play history
Reports you sent to the administrator
retained: A minimal deletion record: your Discord id, the type of event, and timestamps. It is kept indefinitely so the operator can show that the deletion happened.
The shared game catalog: game titles, aliases, metadata, and catalog covers. This is not personal data about you and stays after your account is gone.

Backups: your data can persist in the daily backups for up to 7 further days before the last copy rotates out. Worst case, about 15 to 16 days pass between your request and the last residual copy disappearing.
public.partialTitle: Deleting some of your data without closing your account
public.partialIntro: You do not have to delete your account to remove data. In the web app and the Android app you can:
partial: Delete individual game sessions. Deleted sessions go to the trash and are removed permanently after 7 days, or immediately if you delete them from the trash.
Remove library preferences and your own tags on a game.
Turn off push notifications and the weekly digest, and unregister a device.
public.partialContact: For anything else, including a copy of your data or deletion of specific records, write to the address below. The aim is to answer within one month.
public.noAccessBody: Email the address below from the Discord account linked to GameTrace and we will delete the account manually.
